resources.name: POST /opex/v1/bank-account
resources.description:
Auth:
- Bearer user-token is required.
- Requires a valid authenticated user JWT.

Validation:
- Exactly one of `cardNumber` or `iban` must be provided.
- Providing both or neither is invalid.

Request body: AddBankAccountRequest
{
  "name": "string | null",
  "cardNumber": "string | null",
  "iban": "string | null"
}

Valid request with card number:
{
  "name": "My Bank Account",
  "cardNumber": "6037991234567890",
  "iban": null
}

Valid request with IBAN:
{
  "name": "My Bank Account",
  "cardNumber": null,
  "iban": "IR123456789012345678901234"
}

Invalid request: both cardNumber and iban are provided.
{
  "name": "My Bank Account",
  "cardNumber": "6037991234567890",
  "iban": "IR123456789012345678901234"
}

Invalid request: neither cardNumber nor iban is provided.
{
  "name": "My Bank Account",
  "cardNumber": null,
  "iban": null
}

Response 200: BankAccountResponse
{
  "id": "Long | null",
  "name": "string | null",
  "cardNumber": "string | null",
  "iban": "string | null",
  "accountNumber": "string | null",
  "bank": "string | null",
  "status": "WAITING | VERIFIED | REJECTED"
}

Response 401:
No response body.

resources.name: DELETE /opex/v1/otc/transitive-symbols
GET /opex/v1/otc/transitive-symbols
GET /opex/v1/otc/route
resources.description:
Auth:
- Public endpoint. No Bearer token is required.

Query params:
- sourceSymbol: string, optional. If omitted, all possible source symbols are considered.
- destSymbol: string, optional. If omitted, all possible destination symbols are considered.

Route calculation behavior:
- If both sourceSymbol and destSymbol are provided, routes are calculated for that specific pair.
- If sourceSymbol is omitted, routes are calculated from all possible source symbols.
- If destSymbol is omitted, routes are calculated to all possible destination symbols.
- If both are omitted, routes are calculated for all possible symbol combinations.
- Do not send the literal string "null". Remove/disable the query parameter when it should be treated as null.

Usage examples:
- Specific pair: keep both sourceSymbol and destSymbol.
- All destinations from one source: keep sourceSymbol and remove/disable destSymbol.
- All sources to one destination: keep destSymbol and remove/disable sourceSymbol.
- All possible combinations: remove/disable both sourceSymbol and destSymbol.

Response 200: CurrencyExchangeRatesResponse
{
  "rates": [
    {
      "sourceSymbol": "string",
      "destSymbol": "string",
      "rate": "BigDecimal",
      "isSwappable": "boolean"
    }
  ]
}

parameters.name: sourceSymbol
parameters.description: Optional source currency symbol. If omitted, all possible source symbols are considered. Remove/disable this parameter instead of sending the literal string "null".

parameters.name: destSymbol
parameters.description: Optional destination currency symbol. If omitted, all possible destination symbols are considered. Remove/disable this parameter instead of sending the literal string "null".
